events.title: Purification of the Heart: Diagnosing diseases and implementing cures
events.description: Join us for a spiritually enriching evening with Sheikh Hisham Al Qaisi, visiting from Chicago, as we explore the importance of purifying our hearts and strengthening our connection with Allah (SWT).Our hearts are at the center of our faith, intentions, and actions. Through this insightful session, we will learn how to recognize spiritual diseases, understand their impact on our daily lives, and discover practical remedies rooted in the Qur'an and Sunnah.Topics of Discussion:Diseases of the Heart: Recognizing pride, envy, jealousy, arrogance, and other spiritual challenges.Spiritual Diagnosis: Understanding how these diseases develop and influence our faith, character, and relationships.Purification of the Heart: Exploring Islamic teachings on Tazkiyat al-Nafs.Implementing Cures: Learning practical remedies through repentance, dhikr, sincerity, and self-reflection.Lasting Spiritual Growth: Developing habits that nurture a pure heart and strengthen our relationship with Allah (SWT).When:  Friday, November 20th | After Maghrib until IshaWhere: MCA Khadijah Banquet HallRSVP

events.title: From Tahrir to Gaza: Lessons from Egypt’s Revolution
events.description: 15th anniversary of the egyptian revolution, a conversation with local author Rusha Latif and Political science professor Yasmeen Daifallah about lessons learnt and the cascading effects over 15 years laterNearly sixteen years after the 2011 Egyptian Revolution, we return to the experiences of the young people who ignited it and the questions their struggle continues to raise today.Drawing on Rusha Latif’s book Tahrir’s Youth: Leaders of a Leaderless Revolution, based on her firsthand research during the revolution, we will reflect on the legacy of Tahrir amid the ongoing genocide in Gaza and the widening conflict across the Middle East. In a moment shaped by the struggle for Palestinian liberation and renewed waves of popular resistance around the world, what can Egypt’s revolution teach us about movement-building, political imagination, and the possibilities of collective struggle? And how might its lessons speak to the challenges facing the Ummah today?When:  Friday, Nov 20, 2026 | UPDATE: New Time7:30 - 9:00 pm (after Isha)Where: MCA Maryam HallRSVP

events.description: Join us every Tuesday evening at Masjid Noor as we study Mishkat al-Masabih, one of the most celebrated compilations of the Sunnah.
